# Externship Program Update

The externship program at Penn Carey Law continues to grow. Mark Calloway, Executive Director of the Externship Program, reports that 240 students participated in the 2024-25 academic year — a 12% increase over the prior year.

Calloway's office worked closely with Kathy Lambert, Practice Professor of Law, to expand the curriculum. Lambert designed three new clinic placements for the spring semester.

A separate initiative led by Professor Quentin Reynolds-Maxwell of the Penn Carey Law faculty piloted an externship in IP transactional practice during the same period. Reynolds-Maxwell reports strong student demand.
